svg.title: A looping program runs laps
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn picture. An oval running track seen from above at an angle, with JMP HERE painted on it. A person in a green T-shirt with headphones runs laps on the track, with motion lines behind; a label "board" points to the runner. At the edge of the track a person in a blue T-shirt holds up a sheet that says C 0080:0100, and the bubble says "Excuse me?"; a label "page" points to that person.
